name: Native Instruments Maschine MK3 (MIDI mode)
source: A stopgap until the native driver (M7): Maschine's MIDI mode, set up in NI's Controller Editor to send these notes and CCs.
notes: Unverified: set the Controller Editor's MIDI mode template to match (pads C1 up from the bottom-left on channel 1, knobs CC 70 to 77 relative in two's complement). No lights or displays in MIDI mode.
